name: toxiproxy
description: Shopify's TCP proxy for chaos engineering — injects latency, jitter, bandwidth limits, and connection failures to test network resilience

install_steps: Or download toxiproxy-cli + toxiproxy-server binaries from https://github.com/Shopify/toxiproxy/releases
Or: docker pull ghcr.io/shopify/toxiproxy (server in container)
Start the daemon first: toxiproxy-server (listens on :8474)

commands.description: Start the toxiproxy daemon (toxiproxy-server). API listens on :8474 by default; run in background before creating proxies
Create a proxy (toxiproxy-cli create db --listen localhost:26379 --upstream localhost:6379). Traffic to --listen is forwarded to --upstream

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install toxiproxy: brew install toxiproxy; start the server first: toxiproxy-server

commands.description: List all proxies with listen/upstream addresses and state (toxiproxy-cli list). Add --json for machine-readable output
